messages:
harper: Quick roundup from hallway testing — new users consistently miss the quickstart banner on first run. They call it "fluff" and don't realize it launches a runnable demo. leo: Seen that too. The banner CTA reads 'Explore quickstart' which is vague. Also the text color is low contrast on light backgrounds. nina: Accessibility: keyboard users can't land directly on the banner CTA; tab order goes to nav first. Screen reader says 'banner' but doesn't announce the action clearly. fahim: Small wins: 1) change CTA to 'Import quickstart project' 2) increase button contrast to primary-700 and add 12px padding 3) move CTA to be the first tabbable element in the hero region. harper: Add microcopy under the CTA: 'Includes prompts, a demo endpoint, and a short README.' Keep it <90 chars. Also show a single preview thumbnail with alt text. leo: UX variant idea: A vs B — A shows thumbnail + primary CTA, B shows large illustration + bulleted benefits. Run 1 week, measure CTA click-through and time-to-first-model-call. nina: A11y checklist: native Includes runnable prompts, a demo endpoint, and a short README.
``` harper: Action items: harper -> mocks for both variants (due Fri), leo -> prototype accessibility behavior and focus order, nina -> add a11y e2e tests. I'll file a ticket and link mocks. onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-3815 "Quickstart banner: CTA clarity + accessibility" assigned to harper/leo/nina. Due 2026-04-05. :white_check_mark: harper: Will post mocks in #design-review when ready.
